errors.text_span: the solid dark blue line for 'SepLLM (n=128)' closely tracks the trajectory of the purple Vanilla line
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. While the two lines converge and are close in the second half of the plot, their initial trajectories are different. In the initial phase (approx. 0-20,000 iterations), the purple 'Vanilla' line is visibly lower than the dark blue 'SepLLM (n=128)' line.
The description omits a faint vertical green line located near the y-axis, just after the x=0 mark.
